candidates.title: made a quick client-side tool to clean broken JSON and zero-width spaces
candidates.body:
Hey everyone, Built a small in-browser utility over the weekend to fix a recurring annoyance: invisible unicode characters (like \u200B from Notion) breaking JSON parsers, unquoted keys, and smart quotes.

Everything runs completely in the browser memory so no data gets sent anywhere: https://data-sanitizer-pied.vercel.app

Curious what edge cases or format converters you guys would find handy to add to it!

candidates.title: Built a small in-browser tool to kill invisible zero-width spaces and clean JSON
candidates.body:
Hey r/Frontend,

Yesterday I wasted almost an hour debugging a JSON config that turned out to be an invisible zero-width space copied from Notion.

I put together a quick tool with Next.js and Tailwind that auto-repairs malformed JSON, strips rogue unicode/smart quotes, and converts between JSON, YAML, and CSV in real time.

100% client-side with zero telemetry: https://data-sanitizer-pied.vercel.app

Hope this saves someone else from the same headache!

candidates.title: DataPurge: In-browser JSON repair & dirty text sanitizer. Roast it.
candidates.body:
Hey all,

I got annoyed at existing online formatters that send your private API tokens to their servers and bombard you with video ads.

So I built DataPurge — a client-side tool that fixes malformed JSON (missing quotes, trailing commas, Python booleans), removes hidden zero-width spaces from Notion/Slack, and converts between JSON/YAML/XML/CSV in real time.

Site: https://data-sanitizer-pied.vercel.app

Roast the UI, the utility, or tell me why nobody will ever bookmark this.

candidates.title: DataPurge – Instant in-browser data sanitizer and format converter
candidates.body:
Hi all,

Looking for beta testers for DataPurge, a lightweight developer utility that cleans dirty JSON, unescapes logs, strips zero-width spaces, and converts JSON/YAML/XML/CSV completely in your browser memory.

Live tool: https://data-sanitizer-pied.vercel.app

Would love feedback on edge-cases and performance!

candidates.title: A zero-telemetry in-browser JSON repair & text sanitizer tool
candidates.body:
Built a small utility to fix malformed JSON, strip invisible zero-width spaces from Notion/Slack copy-pastes, and convert formats (JSON/YAML/CSV) locally without sending any data to a server.

Check it out: https://data-sanitizer-pied.vercel.app
